result.title: Physics-Guided Flow Matching: A Generative AI Framework for Global Total Electron Content Forecasting
result.summary: Accurate forecasting of global total electron content (TEC) is important for space weather monitoring and the reliable operation of satellite communication and navigation systems. We propose a physics-guided generative artificial intelligence (AI) framework for day-ahead global TEC forecasting. The framework builds on flow matching, which learns to gradually transform samples from an initial distribution into new samples that share the statistical characteristics of the target data. The proposed model incorporates ionospheric dynamics described by a partial differential equation (PDE) into this transformation process, guiding the changes between initial and target samples using physical knowledge. The model further combines the physical dynamics with statistical patterns captured from data to learn this transformation, adaptively adjusting their relative contributions at each location. The model is trained and evaluated using one year of global TEC data generated by the Thermosphere Ionosphere Electrodynamics General Circulation Model (TIEGCM). The results demonstrate that our model improves both spatial and temporal forecasting accuracy over representative benchmarks, including statistical, deep learning, and generative AI methods at all lead times and across latitudes. The average root mean square error (RMSE) is 39.2% lower than that of ConvLSTM and 23.8% lower than that of the same framework without physical guidance. The learned contribution weights vary systematically with latitude and across geographic locations, showing how the physical contribution changes across the forecast domain. These findings demonstrate that explicit physical guidance improves generative forecasts of global TEC and highlight the value of incorporating physical dynamics into generative AI modeling.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出物理引导的 flow matching 生成框架，用 PDE 描述的电离层动力学引导从初始分布到目标 TEC 场的变换，并按位置自适应调节物理项与数据统计项的贡献权重，用于全球 TEC 提前一天预报。
AI.relevance_reason: 空间天气预报本身与 VLM 推理无关，但其「结构化先验引导生成路径 + 按位置自适应分配物理与数据贡献」的机制，可能为 latent 状态更新中先验与学习信号的贡献分配提供可核查的类比线索。
